name: @nomad/per
description: The PER service on Cloudflare: a Worker that serves the private-table lobby from D1 and runs the keeper (container/, the ported Railway service) as a single Cloudflare Container whose data is in D1.

scripts.test: vitest run && cd container && npm test
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run db:migrate:staging && npm run build:staging && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode staging --secrets-file .secrets.staging.json
